description: Say a Site audit issue is not a problem on this site (a redirect you put there, a page kept out of Google on purpose): it stops counting and is listed under Not a problem. not_a_problem: false counts it again. Idempotent.

issue.description: The issue id, as cvl_seo_audit lists it.

not_a_problem.description: false counts it again (the default is true).
